description: Get the state of a message sent with ask_anon, by its Message ID. Poll it until status is "done" (or "failed" / "aborted"): then reply holds the Anon answer. While status is "running", activity shows what Anon is doing right now (each step has a human text and a technical trace), so you can tell at which stage a slow request is. cards hold structured results: swaps, transfers, bridges, lending, vaults, exchange orders, perp positions and automations, each with its state, facts and transaction links. Once the message is final, the same cards are also returned rendered as a self-contained HTML document: a second content block (embedded resource, mimeType text/html) and structuredContent.cardsHtml. If the client can display HTML (artifact, canvas, HTML preview, MCP UI), show that document to the user unchanged, so they see the cards the way the HeyAnon app shows them; otherwise describe the cards from the text. Buttons in the HTML only open web pages (the HeyAnon web app, or a page the card links to); actions that execute something (confirm a swap, cancel an order) are not offered here and must be done in the HeyAnon app. Returns id, status, reply, activity, cards, traceId; the full message is also returned as structuredContent.
name: anon_message

cardsHtml.description: The cards as a self-contained HTML document (dark theme, styles inlined); present once the message is final and has cards

reply.description: Anon answer, present once status is done

title: Get Anon message
